evidence_items.explanation: Controlled introduction of translation-test contamination demonstrates that training exposure can inflate evaluation results, with effects depending on the contamination format. That establishes a mechanism for misleading scores, but not the broader claim about modest real-world shifts in benchmark-optimized systems.
